name: Crazy Bombers: Tabletop Mayhem
summary:
A SMALL ARENA. BIG VICTORIES.
Place a bomb, find your escape and… BOOM! In Crazy Bombers, every broken crate opens a new path and every power-up can turn the match around. Your miniature tabletop awaits in an enchanted forest built for virtual reality.

UP TO 4 PLAYERS SIMULTANEOUSLY
Create an online game or join friends with a short code. Pick your character and vote for the next arena theme; a draw among the votes selects one shared battlefield. Bots fill empty places. Want to practise? Challenge them in
